title: 第26章 太极秘诀
content_zh:
闵嘉庚自与厉宏生比掌后，一直在旁凝神注视王万户、魏从善、赵安全三人，此时眼见魏从善狡计得逞，心想：“王主任帮了我这大忙，眼下他遇上难事，我如何不加理会？”他头脑灵敏，人又顽皮，心念一动，早有计较，见魏从善即将踏出长窗的门槛，突然端起一张椅子说：“魏师傅，我有一事请教。”魏从善一呆，却没将这孩子放在眼内，并不理睬。

    闵嘉庚将椅子在他身前一放，跳上椅子，突然伸出两根指头朝他双眼插去。

    魏从善急怒之下，伸左手在眼前一挡，右手匕首就往他胸口剁去。闵嘉庚早就筹划好了下一步，见匕首刺到，双手握起椅子，急跃而起，人在半空，椅子向他头顶猛砸下去。魏从善伸手格开，怒骂：“小崽子！”闵嘉庚人未落地，已向前扑出，抱住陈梦梅一个打滚，滚开半丈。

    魏从善大惊，纵上抢夺，闵嘉庚钩脚反踢，随即放开陈梦梅站起，施展空手夺白刃抢他手中匕首。魏从善心知不妙，不敢恋战，猛戳一刀，立即转身出厅，却见王万户双手叉腰，神威凛凛地站在厅口。

    这下变化，王万户固然万万猜想不到，厅上众人也无一不大出意料之外。待各人明白他用意，陈梦梅早已获救，魏从善亦已陷入重围。这一来温老太更增恨意，厉氏兄弟妒念转深，岳胜暗叫惭愧，李云喃喃怒骂，但不论是恨是妒，是愧是骂，各人心中均带着三分惊佩赞叹：“若非这小子出此怪招，怎能将魏从善截得下来？”

    王万户对闵嘉庚十分感激，脸上却不动声色，对魏从善淡淡说：“魏师傅，你为了学乱环诀和阴阳诀，伤了两条人命，其实大可不必这么费事。这两篇歌诀在太极门中也算不得是什么了不起的不传之秘，在下不才，倒还记得。你说过要向兄弟讨教，今日就传了于你也自不妨。”众人一呆，均想：“他已难逃你的掌握，却来说反话。”

    却听王万户继续说：“我先说乱环诀与你，好好记下了。”朗声念道：“乱环术法最难通，上下随合妙无穷。陷敌深入乱环内，四两能拨千斤动。手脚齐进竖找横，掌中乱环落不空。欲知环中法何在，发落点对即成功……”

    这八句一念，赵安全与魏从善面面相觑，说不出话来。这八句诗不像诗、歌不像歌的话，正是太极门中的乱环诀。魏从善幼时也依稀听父亲说起过，只全然不懂其中奥妙，万想不到王万户真能原原本本念给自己听。他把心一横，生死置之度外，说道：“其中含义，还请王主任指点。”

    王万户说：“本门太极功夫出手招招成环。所谓乱环，便是说拳招虽有定型，变化却存乎其人。手法虽均成环，却有高低、进退、出入、攻守之别。圈有大圈、小阁、平圈、立圈、斜圈、正圈、有形圈及无形阁之分。临敌之际，须以大克小、以斜克正、以无形克有形，每招发出，均须暗蓄环劲。”他一边说，一边比划各项圈环的形状，又说：“我以环形之力，推得敌人进我无形圈内，那时欲其左则左，欲其右则右。然后以四两微力，拨动敌方千斤。务须以我竖力，击敌横侧。太极拳胜负之数，在于找对发点，击准落点。”

    他所说的拳理明白浅显，人人能解，但其中实含至理。厅上众人均为武学好手，听他口中讲述，手脚比拟，无不出神。能听到这样一位武学名家讲述拳理精义，实是一生中可遇不可求的良机。闵嘉庚凝神倾听，心花怒放，正是如*乐。

    王万户说的是太极拳秘诀，初时厉氏兄弟、温老太、岳胜、李云等还只存着观摩与切磋之心，后来听他越说越透彻，许多长期积在心中的疑难，师父解说不出、自己苦思不明，却凭他三言两语，顿时豁然开朗。

    王万户解释完乱环诀，说道：“口诀只是几句话，这斜圈无形圈使得对不对，发点与落点准不准，可是毕生的功力。你懂了么？”

    魏从善盼望这乱环诀盼了一生，此时听得明白，懂得透彻，知道只要再加十余年苦练，凭此一诀便可成武学大师，不由满心欢喜，又问：“请问那阴阳诀又是如何？”

    王万户说：“阴阳诀也是八句，你记好了。”魏从善听得出神，就似当年听父亲传授武功一般，随口答应：“是，孩儿用心记着。”待出口才惊觉，不由满脸通红，但众人都在倾听王万户讲武，谁也没留意他说些什么。

    只听王万户朗声念道：“太极阴阳少人修，吞吐开合问刚柔。正隅收放任君走，动静变里何须愁？生克二法随着用，闪进全在动中求。轻重虚实怎的是？重里现轻勿稍留。”

    这口诀魏从善却从没听见过，但他此时全无怀疑，用心记忆。王万户拉开架式，比着拳路，说道：“万物都分阴阳。拳法中的阴阳包含正反、软硬、刚柔、伸屈、上下、左右、前后等等。伸是阳，屈是阴；上是阳，下是阴。散手以吞法为先，用刚劲进击，如蛇吸食；合手以吐法为先，用柔劲陷入，似牛吐草。均须冷、急、快、脆。至于正，那是四个正面，隅是四角。临敌之际，务须以我之正冲敌之隅。倘若正对正，那便冲撞，便是以硬力拼硬力。如果年幼力弱，功力不及对手，定然吃亏。”

    闵嘉庚一直在凝神听他讲解拳理，听到此处，心中一凛：“难道这句话是说给我听的么？是说我与厉宏生以力拼力的错处么？”

    却见王万户一眼不望自己，手脚不停，口中也丝毫不停：“倘若以角冲角，拳法上叫作：轻对轻，全落空。必须以我之重，击敌之轻；以我之轻，避敌之重。再说到‘闪进’二字，当闪避敌方进击之时，也须同时反攻，这是守中有攻；而自己攻击之时，也须同时闪避敌方进招，这是攻中有守，此所谓：逢闪必进，逢进必闪。拳诀中说：何谓打？何谓顾？打即顾，顾即打，发手便是。何谓闪？何谓进？进即闪，闪即进，不必远求。倘若攻守有别，那便不是上乘武功。”这番话只将闵嘉庚听得犹似大梦初醒，心想：“要是我早知此理，适才跟厉氏兄弟比武，未必就输。”心中对王万户钦佩到了极处。

    王万户又说：“武术中的劲力千变万化，但大别只有三般劲，即轻、重、空。用重不如用轻，用轻不如用空。拳诀说：双重行不通，单重倒成功。双重是力与力争，我欲去，你欲来，结果是大力制小力。单重却是以我小力，击敌无力之处，那便能一发成功。要使敌人的大力处处落空，我力虽小，却能胜敌，这才算是武学高手。”

    只见他出手比划，许多拳法竟是闵嘉庚刚才与厉宏生对掌时所用。他详加解释，这招如何可使敌招用空，这招如何方始见功。闵嘉庚听到此处，方始大悟：“原来王主任费了这么大力气，却是在指点我学武功。”

    魏从善是叛门奸徒，王万户怎能授他太极秘法？那是他见闵嘉庚拳招极尽奇妙，临敌之际却只凭一己的聪明生变，拳理的根本尚未明白，想是未遇明师指点。武林之中规矩极多，若为别门别派弟子，纵使他虚心请益，也未可便率尔指教，否则极易惹起他本门师长不快，许多纠纷祸患，常由此而起。他不知闵嘉庚无师自通，只凭了祖传的一部秘籍，自行研习而成，眼见他良材美质，未加雕琢，甚为可惜，料想他师长未明武学至理，因此借着魏从善请问之机，将武学的基本道理解说一通，每句话都是切中闵嘉庚拳法的弊端，说得上是倾囊以授。他知闵嘉庚聪明过人，必能体会，至于温老太、厉宏生、厉宏明、岳胜等人虽也听到了，但这些人年纪已大，纵明其理，未必能再下苦功。其余李云、温文新、周银兵等人，看来多半资质有限，不足为道。

    王万户讲解已毕，问魏从善：“我说的可对么？”魏从善说：“承蒙指点，茅塞顿开。早知如此，在下只须向您磕头求教，也不必向师伯师叔苦苦哀求了。”王万户冷然说：“是啊，早知如此，那也不必害死两条人命了。”魏从善一惊，一道凉气从背脊上直透下去，心想：“他好端端传我拳诀，怎么又提此事？”向厉氏兄弟、李云等人一望，见各人脸上均现迷惘之色。
content_en:
Min Jiageng had been watching Wang Wanhu, Wei Congshan, and Zhao An'an from the sidelines since he competed with Li Hongsheng. Seeing Wei Congshan succeed in his trick, he thought to himself: "Director Wang has helped me so much. Now that he is in trouble, how can I ignore it?"He was quick-witted and naughty, and had already made plans in his mind. When he saw Wei Congshan was about to step out of the long window, he suddenly picked up a chair and said, "Master Wei, I have something to ask you." Wei Congshan was stunned, but he didn't pay attention to the child and ignored him.
Min Jiageng put the chair in front of him, jumped on the chair, and suddenly stretched out two fingers and thrust them into his eyes.
Wei Congshan was so angry that he stretched out his left hand to block his face, and then chopped his chest with the dagger in his right hand.Min Jiageng had already planned his next move. When he saw the dagger stabbing him, he grabbed the chair with both hands and jumped up. He was in mid-air when the chair slammed down on his head.Wei Congshan stretched out his hand to block the attack and cursed angrily: "You little bastard!" Before Min Jiageng even landed, he jumped forward, hugged Chen Mengmei and rolled half a foot away.
Wei Congshan was shocked and jumped up to grab it. Min Jiageng kicked back with hook and kick. He then let go of Chen Mengmei and stood up, using his bare hands to grab the dagger in his hand.Wei Congshan knew something was wrong and did not dare to fight. He stabbed him fiercely and immediately turned around and left the hall. He saw Wang Wanhu standing at the entrance of the hall with his hands on his hips majestically.
Although Wang Wanhu could not have guessed this change, everyone in the hall was also surprised.By the time everyone understood his intentions, Chen Mengmei had already been rescued, and Wei Congshan was also trapped in a tight siege.At this time, Mrs. Wen's hatred increased, the jealousy of the Li brothers deepened, Yue Sheng secretly screamed with shame, and Li Yun murmured curses, but whether it was hatred or jealousy, shame or scolding, everyone was filled with admiration and admiration: "If this kid hadn't used this weird trick, how could he have intercepted Wei Congshan?"
Wang Wanhu was very grateful to Min Jiageng, but kept a calm expression on his face. He said to Wei Congshan calmly: "Master Wei, you hurt two lives in order to learn the Luanhuan Jue and Yin-Yang Jue. In fact, there is no need to go to such trouble. These two verses are in Tai Chi Sect.It's not a great secret.I'm not talented, but I still remember it.You said you wanted to ask your brother for advice, so it's okay to tell it to you today." Everyone was stunned and thought: "He can't escape your grasp, but he said something ironic."
But Wang Wanhu continued to say: "I will tell you the Chaotic Ring Technique first, so remember it carefully." He read aloud: "The Chaotic Ring Technique is the most difficult to master, and the combination of up and down is infinitely wonderful. Trapping the enemy deep into the chaotic ring, four or two can move a thousand catties. The hands and feet move vertically to find the horizontal direction, and the chaotic ring in the palm is not empty. If you want to know where the magic in the ring is, you will succeed if you launch and land at the right point..."
As soon as these eight sentences were read, Zhao An'an and Wei Congshan looked at each other, speechless.If these eight lines of poetry don't sound like poetry or songs don't sound like songs, they are exactly the Chaoshuan Jue in Tai Chi Sect.Wei Congshan vaguely heard his father talk about it when he was young, but he didn't understand the mystery at all. He never expected that Wang Wanhu could actually read it to him exactly as it was.He turned his head and said, regardless of life and death, "I would like Director Wang to give me some advice on its meaning."
Wang Wanhu said: "In Tai Chi Kung Fu, our movements form a ring. The so-called chaotic ring means that although the boxing moves are fixed, the changes are based on the person. Although the techniques are all formed into a ring, there are differences in high and low, advance and retreat, in and out, attack and defense. The circles can be divided into large circles, small pavilions, flat circles, standing circles, oblique circles, straight circles, shaped circles and invisible pavilions. When facing the enemy, you must use large to defeat small, oblique to defeat straight, and invisible to overcome everything.Every time I make a move, I must secretly accumulate ring strength." He gestured at the shape of each ring, and added: "I use the force of the ring to push the enemy into my invisible circle.If I want it to be left, I will go left, and if I want it to be right, I will move the enemy with a thousand pounds.The key to victory in Tai Chi lies in finding the right point."
The principles of boxing he described are clear and simple and can be understood by everyone, but they contain profound truths.Everyone in the hall was a master of martial arts, and they were all fascinated by what he said and how he compared his hands and feet.To be able to hear such a famous martial arts master talk about the essence of boxing is truly a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.Min Jiageng listened attentively, and his heart was full of joy, which was exactly the kind of joy he felt.
Wang Wanhu was talking about the secrets of Tai Chi. At first, the Li brothers, Mrs. Wen, Yue Sheng, Li Yun and others only wanted to observe and learn from each other. Later, they listened to him and became more and more thorough. Many problems that had been accumulated in their hearts for a long time, the master could not explain, and they themselves had been struggling, but with his few words, they suddenly became enlightened.
Wang Wanhu finished explaining the chaos ring formula and said: "The formula is just a few words. Whether the slanted invisible circle is correct, the starting point and the landing point are accurate, but it takes a lifetime of skill. Do you understand?"
Wei Congshan had been looking forward to this Chaoshuan Jue all his life. Now he heard it clearly and understood it thoroughly. He knew that as long as he practiced hard for more than ten years, he could become a martial arts master with this technique. He couldn't help but be filled with joy and asked: "What about the Yin and Yang Jue?"
Wang Wanhu said: "The Yin and Yang Jue also has eight sentences, you have to remember it." Wei Congshan listened with rapt attention, as if he was listening to his father teach martial arts, and casually agreed: "Yes, kid, remember it carefully." He was shocked when he said it, and couldn't help but blushed, but everyone was listening to Wang Wanhu's martial arts lecture, and no one paid attention to what he said.
Just listen to Wang Wanhu read aloud: "There are few people who practice Tai Chi Yin and Yang, and ask about hardness and softness. Just close the right corner and let it go. Why worry about the change of movement and stillness? Use the two methods of birth and restraint, and move forward and forward. What is the importance of lightness, weight, virtuality, and reality? Don't leave the lightness behind for a moment."
Wei Congshan had never heard this mantra before, but at this time he had no doubts and memorized it carefully.Wang Wanhu opened his stance, demonstrated the fist path, and said: "Everything is divided into yin and yang. The yin and yang in boxing include positive and negative, soft and hard, hard and soft, extension and flexion, up and down, left and right, front and back, etc. Stretching is yang, bending is yin; up is yang, down is yin. In the loose hand, the swallowing method is the first, and the force is used to attack, like a snake sucking; close the hand to spit out the method.First, use soft energy to sink in, like a cow spitting grass.As for the front, it is the four fronts, and the corners are the four corners.If you are facing the enemy, you will use hard force to fight.If you are young and weak, you will definitely suffer."
Min Jiageng had been listening attentively to his explanation of boxing principles. Hearing this, his heart trembled: "Is this sentence meant for me? Does it mean the fault of Li Hongsheng and I fighting hard?"
But he saw that Wang Wanhu was not looking at him, his hands and feet were not stopping, and his mouth was not stopping at all: "If you use the horn to attack the horn, the boxing method is called: light versus light, and it will all fail. I must use my weight to attack the enemy's lightness; use my lightness to avoid the enemy.When it comes to the word "dodge", when you dodge the enemy's attack, you must also counterattack at the same time.This is defense within the attack; and when you attack, you must also dodge the enemy's attack at the same time. This is the so-called defense within the attack.: When you dodge, you must dodge.What does it mean to attack?When you dodge, you need to dodge.If there is no difference between attack and defense.It's not superior martial arts." These words made Min Jiageng feel like he was waking up from a dream, and he thought: "If I had known this earlier, I might not have lost when I competed with the Li brothers." He admired Wang Wanhu in his heart.
Wang Wanhu added: "The strength in martial arts is ever-changing, but there are only three types of strength, namely light, heavy and empty. It is better to use light than to use heavy, and to use empty instead of light. The boxing formula says: Double will not work, single heavy will succeed. Double is the struggle between strength and effort.I want to go and you want to come, but the result is that my strength is small, and I can hit the enemy's weak points with one shot.If I can make the enemy's strength fail, I can defeat the enemy.This is a master of martial arts."
I saw him making gestures, and many of the punches were actually used by Min Jiageng when he and Li Hongsheng were sparring just now.He explained in detail how this move can make the enemy's moves empty, and how this move can only be effective.When Min Jiageng heard this, he suddenly realized: "It turns out that Director Wang has spent so much effort to teach me martial arts."
Wei Congshan is a traitor and traitor, how can Wang Wanhu teach him the secret of Tai Chi?That was when he saw that Min Jiageng's boxing moves were extremely miraculous, but when facing the enemy, he only relied on his own cleverness to change. He had not yet understood the basic principles of boxing, and he thought it was because he had not received any guidance from a master.There are a lot of rules in the martial arts world. If he is a disciple of another sect, even if he humbly asks for help, he must not be willing to give advice. Otherwise, it will easily cause the displeasure of his master, and many disputes and disasters will often arise from this.He didn't know that Min Jiageng was a self-taught master who only relied on a secret book handed down from his ancestors and studied it on his own. Seeing that he had good talent and good quality, it was a pity that he had not polished it. He expected that his teacher did not understand the fundamentals of martial arts, so he took advantage of Wei Congshan's opportunity to ask questions and explained the basic principles of martial arts. Every sentence he said was clear about the shortcomings of Min Jiageng's boxing method. It can be said that he taught it with all his money.He knew that Min Jiageng was very smart and would be able to understand it. As for Mrs. Wen, Li Hongsheng, Li Hongming, Yue Sheng and others, although they also heard it, these people were already old. Even if they understood the reason, they might not be able to work hard anymore.The rest, Li Yun, Wen Wenxin, Zhou Yinbing and others, seemed to have limited qualifications and were not worthy of the authority.
After Wang Wanhu finished explaining, he asked Wei Congshan: "Is what I said right?" Wei Congshan said: "Thanks to the advice, I suddenly became enlightened. If I had known this, I would only have to kowtow to you for advice instead of begging my uncle." Wang Wanhu said coldly: "Yes, early onKnowing this, there is no need to kill two people." Wei Congshan was startled, and a cold air went down his back, thinking: "He just taught me the boxing skills, why did he mention this again?" Looking at the Li brothers, Li Yun and others, he saw confusion on their faces.
